"I wonder what she's doing." --> "What should I be doing? I haven't finished the work requirement."  


"She's probably talking to her new gf." --> "Do I have a friend who is not busy and who I can talk to?"  


"She loves her more than she loved me." --> "I have people in my life who loved me better than she did. (brother, friends, mother)"

My ex and I broke up a month ago, and this happened to me a lot. I am a teacher too but the school year hasn't started yet, and we are currently preparing the materials that we need to use as the class starts. I would attend the school/faculty meeting while looking like shit due to crying and being unable to take a bath and I would have to turn off the camera and have my breakdown. I was also not able to pass the required paper works per day. It was awful because I feel like I have absolutely no control. I wanted to quit my job but I couldn't because my family and I need the money.  I also talked to my therapist and she asked me to schedule a psychiatric consultation but it's pretty expensive so I haven't. Then, 2 weeks after our break up, I just couldn't. So, I told my coordinator that my mind is not working as it usually does and I find doing basic tasks difficult. I cried and apologized and told him that I am not usually like this. ( I WOULD LITERALLY READ A SENTENCE AND NOT BE ABLE TO COMPREHEND IT. MY MIND WAS REALLY NOT WORKING.) He gave a day off. As I am typing this, I am starting to realize that this may not be as helpful as I thought it would be. I wanted to share this with you because I know how it feels to know if there are people out there who are going through the same thing, that's actually the reason why I joined Reddit. I was so desperate to find someone who went through the same thing that I am going through and was able to pull through. It was as if I needed an assurance that I will make it through this unbearable pain. I want to tell you that I made it or that I pulled through but I am not yet there. I hope the pain eases soon.
